「休息日」是一个开源项目，任何人都可以自行编译项目，或者也可以考虑直接购买本 App 以支持项目。 ----------- 「休息日」是一款内置多种放假模板的节假日闹钟神器，包含中国、日本、新加坡、美国、泰国、韩国的放假信息。 按照步骤做，配合系统的快捷指令自动化（必须配合快捷指令），就不怕放假的早晨被闹钟吵醒了。 除了内置的放假信息外，用户还可以自己手动标记放假上班的安排。 究竟某一天是“休息日”还是“工作日”，一切最终决定权都在你。 （温馨提示：本 App 是付费 App，购买时请确认这个配合快捷指令的节假日闹钟 App 是你需要的吗？） ----------- 最终用户许可协议： https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

交回来的，是能直接用的成品。 不是一段建议，而是一份打开就能看的幻灯片、表格、图表、文档、设计稿或网站。你说出要做的事，剩下的交给它跑完。 【它能帮你做什么】 文档与办公 ・文档处理——合同、报告、规格书丢进来，拆成能逐条对照的表 ・幻灯片——把结论排成能直接上会的页面，.pptx 下载即用 ・电子表格——生成与整理 .xlsx，公式和格式都在 分析与研究 ・数据分析及可视化——多份口径不一的表格对齐、清洗、出图 ・深度研究——多轮检索交叉核对，每个关键数字都带得回原始出处 ・调研（Wide Research）——多个对象、多个维度并排看 视觉与设计 ・生成图片——人物、场景、插画、头像，支持参考图与多轮修改 ・流程图／架构图——谁连着谁、什么顺序，交回一张打开就能看的图 ・设计——海报、封面、宣传图，交回可直接用的成品图 开发与应用 ・网站——双击就打开的页面，手机上也能看 ・应用——单个 .html 文件，数据存在本机、可导出备份 ・游戏——能玩得起来的一局，键盘与触屏都能操作 教育与学习 ・题目讲解——考的是什么、易错在哪一步，再附一道同类题 【会议转写与纪要】 ・普通话、粤语、英语：录音或上传音频，实时转写与翻译 ・自动整理成决议、行动项与待确认问题 ・单次录音最长 5 小时，音频文件上传最大 200MB 【怎么计费】 ・免费开始，即开即用 ・订阅后每月获得一笔积分，任务按实际算力从里面扣 ・积分每月重置，不累积 ・会议转录的额度与任务积分分开计算，互不影响 同一个账号在 www.notteka.com 网页版同步，手机上发起、电脑上接着看。 —— 订阅说明 ・Notteka 订阅为自动续期订阅，中国区 ¥88／月；其他地区价格在 App 内购买页显示，确认购买前会再次告知 ・付款在确认购买时记入 Apple ID 账户 ・订阅在当期结束前 24 小时内自动续期，除非在此之前关闭自动续期 ・续期按当期同一价格收取 ・可随时在「设置 › Apple ID › 订阅」中管理或取消；取消于当期结束时生效 使用条款：https://www.notteka.com/zh/terms 隐私政策：https://www.notteka.com/zh/privacy

应用描述

A collection of small, simple tools, for when things feel too big or complicated Goblin Tools helps turn overwhelming tasks, confusing messages, difficult decisions, and messy thoughts into manageable next steps. This is the official Goblin Tools app associated with goblin.tools. Beware of unofficial copycats. They are not affiliated with Goblin Tools, and some may be misleading or unsafe. Only trust the official app from the verified Goblin Tools publisher. Created with neurodivergent people in mind, Goblin Tools is a collection of tiny, clever helpers for everyday life. It can support people with ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, chronic illness, low-energy days, and anyone who could use a little help getting things done. You get: - Magic ToDo: Break overwhelming tasks into clear, bite-sized steps - Formalizer: Rewrite text to match the tone, style, or level of formality you need - Judge: Get a second opinion on the mood, emotion, or intent behind a message - Professor: Turn complicated subjects into explanations that are easier to understand - Taskmaster: Work through your to-do list one step at a time, without losing focus - Consultant: Compare options and get help making a decision - Estimator: Create rough time estimates for tasks and activities - Compiler: Transform a messy brain dump into an organized list of actions - Chef: Invent recipes using the ingredients you already have Goblin Tools Pro unlocks features that rely on ongoing online services, storage, and continued development, and therefore cannot be sustainably provided for a single fixed purchase price. With Goblin Tools Pro, you can: - Keep your data continuously synced between devices - Create and reuse templates for to-do items - Share the lists you create - Make custom Formalizer tones and use your own voice - Access your history across all Goblin Tools - Use additional Pro features as they are introduced Use Goblin Tools for productivity, planning, communication, decision-making, learning, cooking, and getting unstuck when your brain refuses to cooperate. It is useful for anyone, but especially designed to help untangle the neurospicy challenges of ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, spoonie life, and more. Purchasing the official app helps keep the Goblin Tools website free and ad-free for everyone, while Goblin Tools Pro supports the ongoing services behind its connected features.

应用描述

Rock Drum Machine is a rock drummer in your pocket. It does not loop a recording: it plays like a drummer, adding ghost notes, open hi-hats and fills that change every time. Practice, write songs and play live with drums that feel alive. FREE TO START Download it free and use everything for 7 days. Then unlock the full version with a single one-time purchase. No subscription. Already own Rock DM? Your full version stays unlocked. Nothing to buy again. A DRUMMER THAT JAMS • JAM and INTENSITY: go from a steady beat to a busy, improvising drummer • Fills of variable length that come in the way a drummer would play them, with triplet fills and double bass drum • Automatic fills every few bars, or fire them yourself • Humanize, from Perfect to Drunk ROCK, FROM CLASSIC TO ODD TIMES • 114 grooves and 70 fills in 6 banks: Rock, Grunge, FunkRock, Shuffle, Progressive and Odd Times • 65 real drum sounds, most recorded in three dynamic layers: ghost, normal and accent • 25 factory kits plus two round-robin kits, Stage RR and Vintage RR • Create or edit your own grooves in Edit Mode and Patterns Mode, and save them in your own banks PRACTICE, WRITE, PERFORM • Song Mode: chain grooves and fills into full songs • 8 Live Pads: switch grooves and fire fills on the fly, with a countdown to the change • Portrait layout on iPhone, so it sits on your music stand • Mixer with volume, pan and reverb send for every drum • Four effects: Compressor / Gate, Equalizer, Delay and Reverb • External keyboard support: Space to play and stop, Enter for a fill IN YOUR STUDIO • AUv3 plug-in, plus a new MIDI-only plug-in to drive any other drum instrument • Sound Module: play the kit as a MIDI sampler from your pads or keyboard • MIDI Setup: independent MIDI Clock in and out, MIDI-controllable tempo, shareable maps • Send and receive grooves and Live Pad Sets with the other Lumbeat drummers and iBassist • Share a groove or a song by AirDrop, Mail or Files • Export full audio, multitrack stems and MIDI • Ableton Link and MIDI Clock sync MORE DRUMMERS Mike (Progressive Rock, with heavier, metal-style fills) and John (Classic Rock) are available as separate in-app purchases, each with their own kit and playing style. They are not included in the full version. Requires iOS 16 or later.
